confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation and bar prices carry wider uncertainty, and the July 2026 window may include seasonal rate shifts. FX figure taken from search-result summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rates overview page; I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Japanese regional cities such as Okayama and Hiroshima-area peers, priced below Tokyo, Osaka, and Kyoto, with accommodation benchmarked to business-hotel and guesthouse levels typical of Japanese regional tourism.
